extracted.intended_audience: Cornell community, reporters, media contacts, and members of the public with story ideas
extracted.subtask_description: Information about the Cornell Chronicle as the university's official news source and how to contact the Chronicle or Media Relations Office with story ideas or media queries. Useful when preparing to pitch news or route press-release/media requests to Cornell.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: The site publishes daily news about research, outreach, events and the Cornell community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this as the target content areas when proposing stories or press releases — research, outreach, campus events, and items of interest to the Cornell community are within scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official status / institutional placement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Cornell Chronicle, Cornell’s source of official news since 1969, is part of University Relations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the Chronicle is the university's official news outlet and is managed within University Relations; items that are official university news or originate from university units are especially appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to submit a story idea / contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Have a story idea? Let us know about it. Contact Editor-in-Chief Melanie Lefkowitz at mll9@cornell.edu or another member of the Chronicle staff for assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct pitches or story leads to the named editor or other Chronicle staff via the provided email address; no additional submission format or template is specified on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Physical office address
rubrics_metrics.description: Our offices are at 120 Maple Ave., Ithaca, NY 14850.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a mailing/physical contact location for the Chronicle; useful for sending physical materials or verifying institutional contact info.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media queries and interview requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Media queries and requests for interviews should be directed to the Media Relations Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press officers and media relations staff, rather than the Chronicle editorial staff, handle formal media queries and interview coordination; follow this routing for official interview/press-request handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Copyright notice (page includes a copyright notice).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals that content is copyrighted; if reusing Chronicle material, seek permission or follow their copyright policy (no details provided on this page).
